shared_contexts_found: credentialVault - API keys shared across workspaces
key_findings: F1: Event bus duplication confirmed - two separate event systems (eventBus vs crossWorkspaceEventBus)
F2: Context fragmentation - multiple context providers (ProjectContext, useWorkspaceContext, unified-workspace-context)
F3: BYOK Vault properly implemented with cross-workspace API key access
F4: Cross-workspace file references implemented via CrossWorkspaceReferenceManager
F5: Workspace routing uses TanStack Router with lazy loading per workspace
F6: RAG pipeline indexes content across workspaces but indexing is manual/trigger-based
F7: Search implementation (SearchIndexer) is workspace-scoped, not unified
F8: Chat context sharing exists via crossWorkspaceEventBus for message sent/state update events
critical_issues: P0-001: Duplicate event buses causing event fragmentation
P0-002: Multiple workspace contexts causing inconsistent state
P1-001: Console.log statements in cross-workspace-event-bus.ts:220 leak in production
P1-002: No unified search across all workspaces
P1-003: Event subscription cleanup incomplete in some components
P2-001: Cross-workspace references lack automatic sync on target file deletion
